mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as historical data shows low-rate environments correlate with equity outperformance.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and SPX 20d returns is negative or less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 4.5% signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate combined with a high federal funds rate indicates a monetary policy misstep that exacerbates economic weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term between UNRATE and FEDFUNDS in SPX 20d return regression is not significant (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in housing starts signals weakening residential demand that precedes economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not negative in late-cycle expansions when HOUST declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production indicates manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not negative when INDPRO declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI growth rate exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not negative when CPIAUCSL yoy growth > 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or frequency of negative returns < 60%.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate below 0.5% signals economic deceleration that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not negative when GDPC1 qoq growth < 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or frequency of negative returns < 60%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising level of nonfarm employment signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are not positive when PAYEMS rises (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.
